description.value: Valley Fitness Centre is a community-run gym and physical fitness centre in Invermere, BC, situated in the Columbia Valley region of the Kootenays. Governed by a Board of Directors and boasting nearly 1,800 Facebook followers, it has a strong local membership base. Touring cyclists riding through Invermere may find it a useful stop given its gym facilities in a small mountain town.
